architecture.hexagonal: UI → trusted Tauri driving adapter → M03 binding input port → M04 document owner → M05 material retention output port → adapters
architecture.dependency: M03 depends on owner/retention abstractions; WORK remains authoritative mutable document/history; M05 owns material pin/root records. UI only immutable projection.
architecture.mutation: Only M04 calls existing WORK Undo; M03 cannot own duplicate state.
architecture.transaction: Precommit failures preserve content/history; confirmed commit advances revision and moves one undo entry to redo; retention failure cannot undo that fact. No persistence or baseline ACK.

proof.issuer: M04 document owner; opaque records held server-side
rules: Capture immutable at authorization; sender/window origin established out-of-band, never trust request binding alone.
M04 proof binds context, revision pair, semantic identity and history transition; M03 cannot mint success from an M05 receipt.
M05 issuer proof binds actual pin, workflow operation, scope/provider/epoch and complete root version set; no selected per-kind latest version mixing.
Verify stage-specific membership: restored content LiveDocuments, surviving history UndoHistory, outgoing content RedoHistory; retain union of old/new roots and all unresolved pins on uncertainty.
Receipt mismatch after confirmed M04 commit means AppliedRetentionDeferred, not unchanged error. No artificial rollback or automatic release.
If M04 commit cannot be established, return Indeterminate; preserve evidence and block automatic retry.
Held is valid only with actual issuer attestation; unknown pin state stays unknown in server evidence. Never synthesize Held from transfer failure.
Reject response with revision mismatching original issuer proof, even if wire schema accepts it.
Operation ID uses existing UUIDv5 workflow namespace and role undo/ordinal; no retry ordinal invention.

io.reason: Undo mutates in-memory document/history and retains material roots; it does not persist formal file bytes.

proof.evidence_class: SYNTHETIC_DOCUMENT_FIXTURE; not an issuer receipt or runtime evidence

bdd.Given: a writable document at revision 7 with two Undo entries
bdd.Then: the prior content becomes revision 8 and one entry moves to Redo

bdd.Given: Undo has changed content to revision 8
bdd.When: retention of the outgoing history fails
bdd.Then: revision 8 remains active with retention pending and the actual evidence is retained

bdd.Given: an authorized Undo request has a retained terminal outcome
bdd.Then: the original outcome is returned and no further Undo occurs

bdd.Given: an active revision differs from the requested revision
bdd.When: a new Undo request is submitted
bdd.Then: the request is rejected and content and history remain unchanged
the request is denied without private proof disclosure

bdd.Given: a writable document has no Undo history
bdd.Then: the request is rejected as NoUndo and content and history remain unchanged

bdd.Given: a request contains a client supplied proof field
bdd.Then: the malformed request is rejected before mutation
no formal file save or formal save acknowledgement occurs
